titulo: Why the Risks Our Grandparents Took Feel Unthinkable Now
caption:
Why the Risks Our Grandparents Took Feel Unthinkable Now

Adam Mastroianni's grandparents smoked, rode in the back of pickup trucks and put off the doctor until they had no choice.

Both of his grandfathers died in their sixties. He can get sushi in 30 minutes and might make it to 80, and he writes that those habits now feel unthinkable to him. How differently would you live expecting 65 years instead of 95? One good risk, this week: write yours on the line.

Source: "The Decline of Deviance" by Adam Mastroianni, Experimental History, 28 Oct 2025. Link: https://www.experimental-history.com/p/the-decline-of-deviance . Archive photos behind the cut-out figures: Fylkesarkivet i Vestland and The New York Public Library, via Unsplash. The retelling, and the lines said to you, are ours.
